reviews.x: Years ago, I bought a easyfeet foot scrubber and enjoyed it so much that it is now worn out. So I bought this as a replacement. In the attached picture, the new one is on the left.  Unfortunately, the new brush is not as good. This one is smaller, has fewer bunches of bristles, and less bristles in each bunch. The pumice stone is very small, too. It feels rather chintzy, but it's hard to complain for the price. Good enough, but not great.

This product works great, but if you're ticklish, I wouldn't recommend it. I never even thought about it until I tried it. For me, I'm not too ticklish, but I dont use this boot too often because it feels so uncomfortable for me. But it does do the job it claims to do!! Oh, and if you want to buy it, buy it here! Do not buy it on their web page! I have heard horror stories about the people who run that organization!! They have taken many people's money! When in doubt, try Amazon.

First, only use in a shower with hand grips because you must balance on one foot. Then use liquid soap from a dispenser--a little goes a long way. Then gently run the foot in and out of the brushes. claims.text: Many reviewers report the suction cups do not hold, so the unit slides around or falls off, making it hard to use.
Several reviewers say it works well for washing feet without bending, especially helpful for those with back problems or arthritis.
Some reviewers complain about poor build quality, including rusted brush bases, messy glue, and a cracked pumice stone on arrival.
A few reviewers find the bristles too stiff or uncomfortable, with some bending after brief use and one noting it tickles.
Some reviewers say the newer version is smaller with fewer bristles than the older model it replaced.

qa.q: Does it fit all foot sizes?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: one reviewer says it works for her size 8 women's feet but slips for her husband's size 14 men's feet [1], while other reviewers report it working well without mentioning size limits [2][3][4][6].

claims.text: It worked for a size 8 women's foot but slipped for a size 14 men's foot.
Other reviewers report it working well without mentioning size limits.

qa.q: Will it stay suctioned to the shower floor?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Does it clean between the toes well?
qa.answer: One reviewer says the brush gets in between the toes nicely [1], but another notes it cleans most of the bottom of the foot without specifically confirming between the toes [4].

claims.text: The brush gets in between the toes nicely.
It cleans most of the bottom of the foot.

qa.q: Is it easy to keep clean and free of mold?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
